entities.summary: Aleksandra Nikolayevna Susokolova, better known as Aleksandra Jacobi, was a Russian journalist, memoirist and publicist, translator and publisher who also used the pseudonym Toliverova and signed her work as Peshkova-Toliverova. Her portraits have been painted by her common-law husband Valery Jacobi, as well as Vasily Vereshchagin.
